Title: Siren's Lure and Heidelberg Castle Timing Question

Messages.Author: the1andonlime
Messages.Body:
Is there a window between an action and the combat queued by Siren's Lure for a player to use Heidelberg Castle?

eg:
- vamp A attempts to block an action
- vamp B plays Siren's Lure
- action resolves

Does vamp A's controller have an opportunity at this point to use Heidelberg Castle?

> Name: Siren's Lure
> [BL:R1, LoB:R]
> Cardtype: Action Modifier
> Discipline: Melpominee/Celerity
> [cel] This vampire burns 2 blood to get +1 stealth.
> [mel] Only usable by an unlocked ready vampire other than the acting minion when a minion attempts to block. That minion cannot block this action. Lock this vampire and that minion. Once the action resolves, this vampire enters combat with that minion.
> [MEL] As [mel] above, but do not lock this modifying vampire.
> Artist: Steve Prescott
>
> Name: Heidelberg Castle, Germany
> [DS:U2, FN:PR, KMW:PAl, LoB:PI]
> Cardtype: Master
> Cost: 2 pool
> Master: unique location.
> Lock to move blood, equipment cards and/or retainers between any two ready vampires you control. (You choose the amount of blood you move and which cards you transfer.) Cannot be used during an action.
> Artist: L. A. Williams
>

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
It's part of the action. You can't use Heidelberg Castle before the combat created by Siren's Lure.
